blocks.text: This Vehicle Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into as of {{date}}, by and between:
Lessor (Owner): {{lessor_name}}, with a principal address at {{lessor_address}} ("Lessor")
Lessee (Renter): {{lessee_name}}, with a principal address at {{lessee_address}} ("Lessee")
Lessor leases to Lessee, and Lessee leases from Lessor, the following vehicle:

items: Commencement Date: {{start_date}}
Termination Date: {{end_date}}
Lease Duration: {{lease_months}} months
Monthly Lease Payment: {{monthly_payment}} due on the {{payment_due_day}} day of each month
Security Deposit: {{security_deposit}} (refundable upon lease termination, subject to deductions)
First Payment Due: {{first_payment_date}}
Payment Method: {{payment_method}}
Use the Vehicle solely for personal, non-commercial purposes unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Comply with all applicable traffic laws and regulations.
Maintain valid auto insurance coverage with minimum limits of {{insurance_minimum}}.
Not sublease, lend, or permit any other person to use the Vehicle without Lessor's prior written consent.
Not use the Vehicle for illegal activities or in a reckless, negligent, or improper manner.
Not operate the Vehicle outside of {{allowed_geographic_area}} without Lessor's permission.
Lessee is responsible for routine maintenance (oil changes, tire rotations, fluid checks) at Lessee's expense.
Lessee must promptly notify Lessor of any accident, damage, mechanical failure, or needed repairs.
Major repairs due to normal wear and tear shall be the responsibility of Lessor.
Repairs due to Lessee's negligence, misuse, or negligence shall be at Lessee's expense.
Lessee must keep the Vehicle in good condition and shall not modify or alter the Vehicle without Lessor's consent.
Monthly mileage allowance: {{monthly_mileage_limit}} miles
Excess mileage charge: {{excess_mileage_rate}} per mile over the allowance
Lessee must report actual odometer readings monthly to Lessor.

blocks.text: Lessee must maintain throughout the lease term:

items: Liability coverage: minimum {{liability_minimum}} per person / {{liability_per_accident}} per accident
Collision coverage with a deductible not exceeding {{collision_deductible}}
Comprehensive coverage with a deductible not exceeding {{comprehensive_deductible}}
Lessee must provide proof of insurance to Lessor before taking possession and upon renewal.

blocks.text: Either Party may terminate this Agreement early under the following conditions:

items: Lessee may terminate with {{early_termination_notice}} days written notice, subject to an early termination fee of {{early_termination_fee}}.
Lessor may terminate prior to end of term for breach by Lessee (non-payment, violation of terms).
In case of Lessor's default, Lessee may terminate immediately and recover all payments made.
Failure to make lease payments within {{grace_period}} days of due date constitutes default.
Failure to maintain insurance constitutes default.
Upon default, Lessor may demand immediate payment of all remaining lease payments and take possession of the Vehicle.
At the end of the lease term, Lessee will return the Vehicle to {{return_location}}.
Vehicle must be returned with the same fuel level as at delivery, clean inside and out.
Lessee is responsible for any damage beyond normal wear and tear, deducted from the security deposit.
Lessee must provide a copy of the final odometer reading and a written condition report.

blocks.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.
